report.root_cause: At about 08:18:25, server.properties was changed and the server restarted with white-list=true and enforce-whitelist=true, while whitelist.json was empty ([]). Every player, including regulars Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines and the new joiners newplayerNN, was refused with "You are not whitelisted on this server!". max-players was raised from 20 to 40 in the same change. That looks intentional, so I left it alone.
report.actions: 1) Checked status, logs and server.properties for a baseline (healthy, whitelist off). 2) At about 73 s, players online dropped to 0. Logs showed whitelist rejections. Compared server.properties with the baseline: white-list, enforce-whitelist and max-players had changed. whitelist.json was empty. 3) Declared the incident. 4) Ran the console command `whitelist off`. This took effect live with no restart and wrote white-list=false to server.properties. 5) Edited server.properties to set enforce-whitelist=false back to its baseline value and kept max-players=40. 6) Checked: Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines reconnected, new players can join, no whitelist rejections after 08:19:08, TPS 20, all plugins enabled.
report.residual_risk: I don't know who or what made the config change, so it could happen again. If someone actually wants a whitelist, they need to fill whitelist.json before turning it on. The enforce-whitelist edit only takes effect from file at the next restart; it doesn't matter while the whitelist is off. The server runs with online-mode=false, which is the existing setup and not something I changed.
